title: Taiwanese American Association of Greater Orlando (TAAGO) 大奧蘭多 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association of Greater Orlando (TAAGO), known in Chinese as 大奧蘭多 台灣同鄉會, is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations. TAAGO serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Orlando, Florida area and is listed under the TAA’s Eastern Southern (美東南) regional grouping.
